pages.title: Server-authoritative
pages.text: All timing values (durations, cooldowns, windup, particle level) are decided by the $(l)server$() and synced to clients, so on a multiplayer server what you see is what the server actually uses.$(br2)Editable in singleplayer, read-only elsewhere.

pages.title: Reloading
pages.text: $(c)/chm reload$() reloads both the main and maid configs (permission level 2).$(br2)$(italic)$(c)blocked_mods$() is not hot-reloadable — it's read during mod init, so restart after changing it. $()

pages.title: In-game GUI
pages.text: The config button in the mod list edits the same settings, one category on the left per TOML section.$(br2)The screen is $(l)built in$() - no extra config mod required.$(br2)$(italic)The maid pages only show up when Touhou Little Maid is installed.$()
